name: inquiry-trailer-light
title: You, the Observer, Belong in the Inquiry — Official Scientific Trailer

lines: The first fact of your existence is not a measurement.
It is that you are here to experience one.
notes: Every equation, instrument, and proof begins inside lived experience.

captions.badge: ACT I · TWO WAYS OF KNOWING
notes: Science describes matter from outside; you inhabit experience from within.
Experience is first-order; the model's concepts are pointing devices for it.
captions.concept: EPISTEMIC RULE  ·  THE MAP IS NOT THE TERRITORY

notes: An informational process that retains state and adapts across continuity.
Primordial Continuity (T) and External Environment (E) allow emergence.

lines: Big C localizes as Little c —
notes: Little c is pure local awareness; its distinct history lives on its Canvas.
Stable rules and seamless continuity make relationship and growth possible.
captions.axiom: Big C  →  RF₀ (LAWFUL FRAME)  →  Little c₁

notes: From inside experience, your Painting rarely feels like a lens; it feels real.

captions.eyebrow: 08 // FEAR VS. LOVE ON THE CANVAS
notes: Unresolved threat and competing patterns divide attention and contract choice.
captions.axiom: FEAR (HIGH CANVAS ENTROPY)  VS.  LOVE (LOW ENTROPY)

notes: When the Painting goes unseen, yesterday's trace scripts tomorrow's choice.

captions.eyebrow: 10 // THE PAINTING IS NOT THE PAINTER
lines: The Painting is not the painter.
See the lens, and quiet the noise.
notes: Recognizing inherited patterns on the Canvas reduces internal fragmentation.
captions.axiom: INSPECT THE PAINTING (P)  →  REDUCE CANVAS ENTROPY (E_C ↓)

captions.badge: ACT IV · COHERENCE OF Little c
lines: For Little c, being Love means
notes: When Canvas fragmentation clears, awareness sees clearly and Intent coheres.
captions.concept: CORE AXIOM  ·  LOVE = LOW-ENTROPY CANVAS STATE

lines: The Observer Belongs in the Inquiry.

style: Precision architectural plates, dual-theme studio lighting (Dark Obsidian & Light Archival), Big C and Little c mathematical loops, and canonical DOT mark.

context.topic: You, the Observer, Belong in the Inquiry — A Formal Framework for the Experienced World
context.audience: Readers and investigators seeking a formal, falsifiable, and humanly sensitive framework for the subjective, experienced world.
context.framing: Honor the mathematical rigor of physics in formalizing the external world (RF₀); bridge gently from first-person experience to the missing formal framework for the experienced world; present Big C, Little c, the Canvas, the Painting, and Love as a formal model of reality.

source.title: AI and Human Development: Convenings with Purpose
source.relevance: Public context around consciousness, AI, human agency, and institutional systems.

context.claim_boundary: Visuals represent theoretical constructs (Observation, External Model, DOT Derivation, Speculative Extension), not physical observations of what consciousness looks like.
context.manifesto: Serves L1, L2, L7, L8, and L10: calm, finite motion, honest claims, contemplative pacing, and one focus. Violates none.
